universalization_rule: Common universalization excludes direct technical execution, repo-specific commands, exact file paths, patch recipes, code-bound implementation steps, raw/private text, and prior training-set rows. Later local/user adaptive learning may use client-specific material only after redaction, provenance, and separate adaptive gates.

good_study_candidates.rule: Real prompt/analysis/skill material with approved outcome or clear correction, one reusable boundary, stable ref/hash, no raw private text copied, and no direct technical execution as model content.

evidence_only_backlog.rule: Q1 todo/backlog or supporting refs that may be cited by later review but cannot enter common rows.

too_technical_code_bound_for_universal_r.rule: Code files, tests, build outputs, exact commands, patch recipes, and host-specific execution details are not universal common reasoning rows.

translation_local_wiki_or_orchestration_.rule: Prior training sets, translation/local wiki/orchestration corpora, model-led runs, and generated train-ready packages are excluded from new common DPO rows unless a later review proves a clean, source-disjoint, redacted boundary.

raw_private_redaction_required.rule: Binary/private/corpus/checkpoint/secret-like material must not enter common rows; later adaptive use needs redaction and separate gates.

unknown_needs_review.rule: Insufficient metadata or done candidate without Q2 material-quality approval remains blocked from training.

machine_target_rules.PromptToTask: Accept only real prompts with approved task interpretation, constraints, deliverables, permission boundary, and plausible near miss.

machine_target_rules.user_adaptive: Client AGENTS/CLAUDE/skills/correction history are adaptive-only refs after redaction; raw text is not common training data.
